prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Preview-only high-fidelity desktop Electron dashboard north-star UI comp, landscape 16:10.
Primary request: Design Agent Arena as a late-16-bit tactical RPG battle map / cartridge strategy screen reimagined for two coding agents. This must feel like a real playable strategy interface, not a modern dashboard with pixel-art wallpaper.
Scene/backdrop: A large isometric pixel tilemap owns the center of the composition. Terrain tiles, tactical lanes, nodes, and highlighted move paths visualize real coding-agent attacks and repairs. The battlefield itself carries the main information and action.
Subject and layout: Opposing corner status ribbons show the two agents. One ribbon must read exactly "Codex", "gpt-5.6-sol", "HP 100", and "4/4 checks". The opposing ribbon must read exactly "Claude", "claude-opus", "HP 70", and "4/4 checks". Use original abstract provider crests only, with no copied characters, mascots, game sprites, or logos. A lower cartridge-style HUD contains two real command tiles labeled exactly "Inspect Codex" and "Inspect Claude". Include an evidence log with the exact legible entries "Round 2", "Verify Attacks", "logout-retry", and "Concurrent rotations can both commit".
Style/medium: High-fidelity desktop product UI rendered in authentic late-16-bit pixel-art interface language: isometric pixel tile terrain, cartridge menu panels, hard pixel shadows, bitmap typography, crisp integer pixels, dense functional operator hierarchy.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:10, edge-to-edge application screen, large battlefield centered and dominant, opposing status ribbons anchored in upper corners, lower HUD spanning the bottom. Strong tactical readability and clear information hierarchy.
Color palette: Midnight violet, slate blue, grass green, parchment, burnt orange, and aqua.
Text (verbatim): "Agent Arena"; "Codex"; "gpt-5.6-sol"; "HP 100"; "4/4 checks"; "Claude"; "claude-opus"; "HP 70"; "Inspect Codex"; "Inspect Claude"; "Round 2"; "Verify Attacks"; "logout-retry"; "Concurrent rotations can both commit".
Constraints: Product name Agent Arena must be visible. All listed interface text should be legible and spelled accurately where possible. Real attacks and repairs appear as highlighted tactical moves on the map. Functional, dense operator hierarchy. Zero rounded SaaS cards. No gradients, no blur, no glassmorphism.
Avoid: Modern analytics dashboard framing, pixel-art wallpaper behind SaaS cards, rounded cards, excessive empty space, gradients, blur, glass effects, copyrighted game sprites, copied characters, third-party logos, watermark, illegible decorative text.
